title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 220 ]

blocks.text: A common belief is that if we find someone who likes to do the same things we do, then we will get along and we will be happy. Participating in activities together is a great start for relationships; however, I am sure you know people who like to do the same things but who don't get along. This is true with individuals who belong to the same social groups, companies, and teams, as well as other organizations. Obviously, it is not a common interest alone that creates harmonious relationships.

readingSentences.english: A common belief is that if we find someone who likes to do the same things we do, then we will get along and we will be happy.
readingSentences.korean: 일반적인 믿음은 우리가 하는 것과 같은 일을 좋아하는 사람을 찾으면 서로 잘 어울리고 행복해질 것이라는 점이다.

readingSentences.english: Participating in activities together is a great start for relationships
readingSentences.korean: 함께 활동에 참여하는 것은 관계 형성에 훌륭한 출발점이다.

readingSentences.english: however, I am sure you know people who like to do the same things but who don't get along.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 같은 일을 좋아하면서도 잘 어울리지 못하는 사람들을 여러분도 분명 알고 있을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: This is true with individuals who belong to the same social groups, companies, and teams, as well as other organizations.
readingSentences.korean: 이것은 다른 단체들뿐만 아니라 같은 사회적 모임, 회사, 팀에 속한 개인들에게도 해당된다.

readingSentences.english: Obviously, it is not a common interest alone that creates harmonious relationships.
readingSentences.korean: 분명히 조화로운 관계를 만들어내는 것은 공통의 관심사만은 아니다.
